quantumroute_comparison.adapter: ibm_qaoa_adapter.py builds and locally transpiles a route-QUBO QAOA circuit; it does not identify historical jobs.
quantumroute_comparison.execution: ibm_execution.py accepts a saved job ID only when it has an execution package; recovery does not create that package or assert a prior submission.
quantumroute_comparison.qubo: The current route QUBO and its signature cannot be attributed to this historical job without retrievable inputs or provenance.
quantumroute_comparison.evidence_validator: This marked recovery record is deliberately not a verified evidence record and must not be passed as hardware evidence.
